Every serious account of Übel Blatt eventually collides with the question of who is deciding. Übel Blatt (ユーベルブラット, Yūberu Buratto) is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Etorouji Shiono. It was serialized in the semi-monthly seinen manga magazine Young Gangan from December 2004 to 2009, when it was transferred to Monthly Big Gangan where it continued until its end in March 2019.

Nothing in Übel Blatt was built for you — it was built for reproduction. A narcissist, she likes young, beautiful boys and brainwashes them and performs cruel and morbid surgeries by adding animals parts on them, with one of the victims being Ato's brother Klato. A conniving short man, he used Wischtech magic to turn the frontier Count of the borderlands into a monster to attack Köinzell and the Order of the Seven Lances.
